messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Ibuprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).
Ibuprofen works by reducing hormones that cause inflammation and pain in the body.
Ibuprofen is used to reduce fever.
Ibuprofen is used to treat pain or inflammation.
The pain or inflammation is caused by many conditions.
These conditions include headache, toothache, back pain, arthritis, menstrual cramps, or minor injury.
Ibuprofen is used in adults and children.
Some formulations are also used in premature babies to close a certain heart defect.
Triplet: ["Ibuprofen", "used in", "premature babies"]

The relation 'used in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used in the patient population or group specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
